title: Human nature · speaking rehearsal
intro_questions: What experience do you have of this topic?
Has your view changed over time?
cue: Describe a person whose qualities you admire, using examples of what they do.
points: what or who you are describing
how you first learned about it
specific details or examples
why it matters to you
followups: How might other people have different views of this topic?
What advantages and difficulties can arise?
How could the situation change in the future?
checks: I answered directly and developed my ideas.
I used precise vocabulary and appropriate collocations.
I linked a reason and a relevant example.
I paraphrased or corrected myself when needed.
